stage00.canonicalParagraph: Operators **must** review the [approval boundary](../approval-boundaries.md) before changing repository state, retain the exact validation evidence for the affected scope, stop when authority is missing, and route every exception to the named canonical owner before resuming the controlled operation.
stage00.referenceParagraph: Operators must review the [approval boundary](../../../../00.agent-governance/rules/approval-boundaries.md "owner") before changing repository state, retain the exact validation evidence for the affected scope, stop when authority is missing, and route every exception to the named canonical owner before resuming the controlled operation.

policy.canonicalParagraph: Every platform change requires a documented rollback boundary, an identified operator, verification against the declared desired state, and explicit separation between repository-static evidence and any live cluster observation that has not been directly authorized and recorded.
policy.referenceParagraph: Every platform *change* requires a documented rollback boundary, an identified operator, verification against the declared desired state, and explicit separation between repository-static evidence and any live cluster observation that has not been directly authorized and recorded.

runbook.canonicalParagraph: Before recovery begins, capture the current symptoms and immutable identifiers, verify prerequisites without exposing secret values, execute only the approved bounded commands, compare the result with the acceptance criteria, and record rollback or escalation evidence when any check fails.
runbook.referenceParagraph: Before recovery begins, capture the current symptoms and immutable identifiers, verify prerequisites without exposing `secret values`, execute only the approved bounded commands, compare the result with the acceptance criteria, and record rollback or escalation evidence when any check fails.
